cc:Work.dc:title: SteppedClosedBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Fully closed box with a raised rear section.
Two rectangular prisms sharing the same bottom, joined along their full width x. The main section spans the full inner depth y at inner height h. The raised rear section sits on top of the back portion, with inner depth y2 and additional inner height h2. No internal wall separates the two volumes. All dimensions are inner (clear) dimensions.
Cross-section viewed from either end (y = depth, z = height)::
_______ | | } h2 _________________| rear | | front section | | | h | | |_________________|______| <--- y1=y-y2 ---><- y2 -> <------------- y ------->
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes SteppedClosedBox --x 121 --y 101 --h 24 --h2 19 --y2 38 --thickness 3.0 --output /tmp/clavinet_preamp_enclosure.svg Command line short: boxes SteppedClosedBox --output
